### Same selector + body in a different context

- `html {touch-action: manipulation; accent-color: var(--accent)}`: app-a/app-b/app-c in `@layer base`; app-e in `(top level)`
- `.t-modal {transform-origin: center; transform: translate(-50%, -50%)scale(var(--modal-scale)); opacity: 0; pointer-event`: app-a/app-c/app-d/app-e in `@layer components`; app-b in `@layer components > @media (min-width: 640px)and(min-height: 501px)`
- `.t-modal.is-open {transform: translate(-50%, -50%)scale(1); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto}`: app-a/app-c/app-d/app-e in `@layer components`; app-b in `@layer components > @media (min-width: 640px)and(min-height: 501px)`
- `.scrollbar-thin::-webkit-scrollbar {width: 6px}`: app-a/app-b/app-d/app-e in `@layer utilities`; app-c in `@layer utilities > @supports not(scrollbar-color: auto)`

- `::view-transition-group(*), ::view-transition-old(*), ::view-transition-new(*) {animation: none !important}`: app-a in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`; app-c in `@layer components > @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`
- `html[data-page-motion="off"]::view-transition-group(*), html[data-page-motion="off"]::view-transition-old(*), html[data-`: app-a in `(top level)`; app-b/app-c in `@layer components`
- `html[data-page-motion="off"] .animate-in, html[data-page-motion="off"] .animate-out {animation-duration: 0s !important; `: app-a in `(top level)`; app-b/app-c in `@layer components`
